svg.aria-label: Simulation of one file written twice. Cat prints the page from Unit 1. Echo on its own prints the heading to the terminal; adding a redirect empties index.html first and only then writes the heading into the empty file. A double arrow appends a paragraph without emptying anything. Running the first line again empties the file a second time, so the appended paragraph is gone, and the ledger of line counts reads one, zero, one, two, zero, one.
